title: Fracturing Orbs from Cleansed maps
summary: Clear a Corrupted Nexus so the corrupted maps around it turn Cleansed, then run those with Hidden Scars and From Distances Untold: Cleansed monsters and modded Summoning Circle bosses can drop Fracturing Orbs.

budget.build_needs: Beats the Corrupted Nexus boss and clears Cleansed maps, which add extra packs of Cleansed monsters.

claim.note: Editorial estimate from what the setup needs; not measured.

yields.why: Hidden Scars: Cleansed Monsters have a chance to drop Fracturing Orbs; From Distances Untold: modded Summoning Circle Bosses in Cleansed Areas have a 5% chance.

nodes.name: Evolutionary Pressure
nodes.effect: 1% increased Rarity of Items Dropped by Monsters, 2% increased Effectiveness of Monsters and 3% increased chance of Monster Modifiers on Rare Monsters, each per Explicit Modifier on the Map

nodes.name: Improved Calibration
nodes.effect: Waystones have 25% more effect of Prefix Modifiers or 25% more effect of Suffix Modifiers when opening Maps

nodes.name: Volatile Connection
nodes.effect: 15% chance areas are Cleansed or Corrupted

claim.note: Owner's notes pick Doryani; poe2db's Corrupted Nexus page has Doryani reward Nexus clears. The node picks are our synthesis. T4 is a free pick: no Doryani T4 node touches Cleansed maps or Summoning Circles.

waystone.notes: Owner's order. A Corrupted Nexus only opens with a waystone of 4+ modifiers.

claim.note: Owner's run notes; the 4-modifier requirement is from poe2db's Corrupted Nexus page (community wiki section).

steps: Run the Corrupted Nexus with a waystone of at least 4 modifiers; clearing it turns the surrounding corrupted maps Cleansed.
Set Doryani: Evolutionary Pressure, Improved Calibration, Volatile Connection; T4 is a free pick.
Allocate Hidden Scars and From Distances Untold; take Summoning Circles on The Chosen Path and Overlord's Domain.

Run each Cleansed map with a tablet carrying the Summoning Circle prefix and one suffix (Summoning Circle chance or the extra Rare Modifier on Unique Monsters). They roll on any base; an Overseer Tablet also feeds Lord of the Runes.
Kill every Cleansed pack and every Summoning Circle boss.
risks: Hidden Scars gives no rate ('a chance'), so orbs per map are unknown.
0.5.5: a failed Corrupted Nexus can be retried, and the Immured Fury must be killed to complete its map.
Some Cleansed modifiers add +1 Monster Level and many extra Cleansed packs.
